Dear Mom and Dad,

As Christmas arrives once again, I am reminded of the warmth and love you have always brought into my life. Your sacrifices, guidance, and endless support are gifts that I cherish far more than anything wrapped under the tree. I am deeply grateful for everything you do and everything you are. May this season fill your hearts with peace, joy, and the same love you constantly give me.

Eight months nalang graduate nako. Tapos naa pay four months bago ko makauli. Antuson nalang gamay jud. Free na dayon mo tanan after. Sorry kung dili ko expressive. And yes Advanced Merry Christmas! Sana aabot pa hanggang 80. Kaya yan! Konting tiis per day lang yan. Hapit ko makalimot. Advanced Happy New Year!
